key.name: pinned
key.summary: What's pinned to the taskbar, in order
key.description: Each entry is an app's desktop file ID ("org.gnome.TextEditor.desktop") or a role: "role:web", "role:terminal", "role:files" or "role:mail". A role is a slot for whichever app is the default for that job: it opens that app, and the app's windows show under it.

key.name: terminal-app
key.summary: The app the terminal slot opens
key.description: A desktop file ID. Empty: Patrone Terminal, or another terminal if it isn't installed. (Web browser, files and mail follow the system's default apps instead.)

key.name: web-search-url
key.summary: Where web searches from the Start menu go
key.description: "%s" is replaced with the search terms. Opened with the default web browser.
